This plot is small, only a quarter of my land, so I will not spend much cash on it. I have some schooling but money is tight, and I will use the manure from our animals since that costs nothing. I will plant seed I saved from last season because improved seed is expensive and not always available in my kebele. My family and I will do most of the work ourselves, and maybe I will ask a neighbor to help for a few days during weeding.
